mentions.name: Duolingo for sales
mentions.description: A gamified app for learning sales skills, styled as a "Duolingo for sales"; it has morphed into an eval benchmark for sales agents, with the focus on making the learning experience feel fun rather than a basic quiz workflow.
mentions.problem: Making it feel fun versus a basic quiz workflow is the hardest part; the project also suffers from classic cognitive feature creep.
mentions.source_excerpt: so I’ve been building a “Duolingo for sales” to try to teach myself more. it’s started to morph a bit into an eval benchmark for sales agents, so classic cognitive feature creep.
mentions.author: BSOhealth
